dimensions.evidenceB: The genealogy counts Adam’s years before death.
dimensions.label: Time wording

evidence.observation: The man is told that in the day he eats from the prohibited tree he will surely die.
Adam’s years total nine hundred thirty before the genealogy says that he died.

record.tension: The warning names death in the day of eating, while the genealogy records many years before Adam dies.
record.title: When does Adam die?
